categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the international tourism hotel industry, offering hotel accommodations, dining services including restaurants, cafes, bars, and clubs, as well as conference and banquet facilities. It also engages in real estate development, property management, food wholesale and manufacturing, and general investment activities through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes high-quality service management and culinary expertise, including specialized dining experiences such as Michelin-starred restaurants and sustainable seafood practices. It employs standardized operational processes, quality control systems like HACCP for food safety, and integrates IT systems for booking and information security management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are domestic and international travelers, including business and leisure tourists. The company serves high-end consumers seeking premium hotel accommodations and fine dining experiences, with a focus on Taiwanese, Japanese, American, and other Asian visitors. It also targets corporate clients for meetings and events.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, with major facilities in Taipei, Hsinchu, and Kaohsiung. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a focus on Taiwanese travelers and inbound tourists from Japan, the US, and other Asian countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily downstream in the hospitality and service supply chain, providing end-customer services such as lodging, dining, and event hosting. It sources food and beverage supplies from upstream vendors and manages property and facility operations internally and through subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include asset revitalization through property redevelopment, transitioning to a light-asset business model, talent development via structured training programs, and enhancing service quality. The company focuses on sustainability and ESG initiatives, food safety improvements, digital marketing, and expanding domestic tourism in response to pandemic impacts.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through hotel room rentals and food and beverage sales, accounting for approximately 23% and 75% of total revenue respectively. Additional income comes from property leasing, event hosting, and ancillary services. The company also earns investment income from subsidiaries and real estate development projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading Taiwanese hotel group with a strong brand reputation for quality service and culinary excellence, including Michelin recognition. It competes with other international and domestic hotel chains in the upscale hospitality market, leveraging its multi-location presence and integrated service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the latest fiscal year, the company reported total assets of approximately NT$18.6 billion and net equity of NT$13.4 billion. Annual revenue was about NT$1.45 billion with a net profit turnaround to NT$1.09 billion after pandemic-related losses. The company is undergoing transformation with asset redevelopment and expects gradual recovery in occupancy and revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes a premium hospitality experience combining classic and innovative culinary offerings, personalized customer service, and high-quality facilities. Its unique value lies in its heritage brand, multi-generational talent cultivation, sustainable practices, and integration of local cultural elements to enhance guest experiences.
